sentences.text: This northern fur seal was tracked from {first_date} to {last_date}, a span of {days_tracked}.
Northern fur seals breed on islands in summer, mostly the Pribilof Islands, and spend the winter at sea.
Its track runs from {northernmost_lat} down to {southernmost_lat}.
It was farthest from where its track began, {max_displacement_km} away, on {farthest_date}, just days before the record ends.
